analysis.narrativeEn:

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.8→39.1) + entering oversold + continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.8761→-6.8399) + worsening diagnosis + signal of continued bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $413.55) + band width at 16.70% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($419.19) + basis (lower BB, near Pivot S1).
· Swing resistance ($421.97) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x) + reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + buy entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see.
